nodes.label: YCR ("The Highway") & KMK Platform
nodes.rationale: Web platform for UKM Keluarga Mahasiswa Katolik (KMK) Universitas Ciputra powering Youth Catholic Revival (YCR — "The Highway"), Webinar, Ziarah, and Baksos

nodes.label: Team & Ownership Architecture
nodes.rationale: Assigns strict directory and file scope per team member (Gee, Ken, Dave, Sean, Keane) to guarantee zero merge conflicts and preserve modularity

nodes.label: Shared Constants (src/lib/constants.ts)
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for dates (YCR_OPENS_AT, YCR_DATE_MIDNIGHT), base pricing (PRICE_WEBINAR_IDR, PRICE_YCR_INDIVIDUAL_IDR), and group discount tiers (DISCOUNT_TIER_5, DISCOUNT_TIER_10)

nodes.label: Shared Contracts Layer (src/lib/contracts/)
nodes.rationale: Strict contract layer between Frontend and Backend covering common, registration, timeline, marketplace, donations, payments, and admin schemas

nodes.label: Sunlit Highway Design System
nodes.rationale: UI components must consume CSS variables in src/app/tokens.css and follow docs/DESIGN.md (Sunlit Gold, Desert Amber, Highway Blue, Lilita One, Nunito)

nodes.label: Expanding Timeline Bar & D-Day Hero Stage
nodes.rationale: Pre-D-Day pinned milestone bar that automatically expands when Date.now() >= YCR_DATE_MIDNIGHT into the primary visual hero Rundown Showcase stage

nodes.label: Context-Aware Paid Registration Form
nodes.rationale: Renders paid Webinar before YCR_OPENS_AT and paid YCR (Individual/Group with volume discounts) on/after YCR_OPENS_AT

nodes.label: Next.js App Router RSC & Leaf Client Architecture
nodes.rationale: Defaults to React Server Components for data fetching, restricts 'use client' to leaf interactive components, and forbids importing admin.ts in client bundles

nodes.label: Database RLS & Atomic Row-Lock RPCs
nodes.rationale: Requires ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all Supabase tables and atomic quota/registration transactions via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE to prevent overselling

nodes.label: Payment Webhook Integrity & Idempotency
nodes.rationale: Prevents frontend callbacks from marking orders PAID; requires server-to-server HMAC-SHA256 verification and idempotent 200 OK handling

nodes.label: Mobile-First UX Guardrail
nodes.rationale: 85%+ mobile traffic requires >=44x44px tap targets and responsive layouts from 375px viewport up to 4K displays
